Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recording is for the claim file. Can you confirm you're
comfortable continuing?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Where were you sitting when the collision happened?
A: I was in the front passenger seat of the car. My friend was driving.
Q: Can you describe where you were headed and what the vehicle was doing right before the impact?
A: We were heading down a main road in Houston, and my friend started turning left at an intersection. We were
waiting for a gap in traffic, and then a vehicle coming the other way hit us on the driver's side of the front.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the collision?
A: Not really. I was looking down at my phone when we started the turn. I heard a horn and then there was a loud
bang.
Q: Did the airbags deploy?
A: Yes, the passenger airbag came out and hit my arm and shoulder. I got pushed against the door.
Q: Where were you injured?
A: My right wrist. It hurt immediately and I couldn't move my hand. They took me to the emergency room, and I was
told the wrist was fractured. I've been wearing a splint since then.
Q: Have you seen a doctor snice the emergency room visit?
A: Yes, I have a follow-up with an orthopedic specialist next week. They mentioned I might need a cast for several
weeks.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?
A: Just that I'm not sure yet how much time I'll miss from work, since I work with my hands. I'd appreciate it if you
could keep me updated on the claim.
Q: Thank you. I'll note that and follow up with you soon.
A: Thanks, I appreciate it.
</page>
